title: Refactor properties that copy collections into methods across 10+ files
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
17 instances across multiple files where properties return defensive copies of collections, violating the rule that properties should not copy collections:

**Razor Pages:**
- `About.razor` L124 (FilteredLicenses)
- `Admin.razor` L752 (SettingCategories), L759 (FilteredEditableSettingGroups), L766 (FilteredEditableSettings), L782 (FilteredConfigurationItems), L848 (FilteredAudit), L850 (FilteredHistory)
- `Chat.razor` L558 (TraceTurns)
- `Maintenance.razor` L206 (ProposalActionRows)
- `ProposalDiffViewer.razor` L14 (Lines)
- `Proposals.razor` L351 (FilteredProposals)
- `TopicMapVisualization.razor` L76 (LayoutEdges)

**Controllers & Services:**
- `McpController.cs` L18 (ToolNames), L21 (EnabledMcpTools)
- `ChatToolCatalog.cs` L100 (All), L109 (McpTools)
- `MemoryQueries.cs` L27 (Diagnostics)
- `SecurityServices.cs` L407 (Roles)

## Impact
Properties that copy collections cause unexpected allocations on every access, violate `{ get; }` design conventions, and mislead callers about performance characteristics.

## Action Required
Convert each property to a `GetXxx()` method returning `IReadOnlyList<T>` or cache the collection as a `List<T>` field. Add `[Obsolete]` on the old property with migration guidance if needed.

## Effort
~85min

## Priority
P1 — Maintainability
